title: Night of decree or Christmas?
translation: We sent it down on the Night of Decree. What will make you know it? The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months. In it the angels and the Spirit descend, by their Lord’s leave, with every matter. Peace it is, until dawn.
body: **Luxenberg** read this as a Christmas hymn (qadr as Syriac “birth fate”). **Sinai (2012)** finds that arbitrary: anzala sends down revelation, never a person; qadr is “decree”. Yet its angels echo **Luke 2**, where Luther stresses the angel’s “**to you**”.
question: Does this night of angels and peace echo Christmas, or an Arabian night of decree?
source_label: Sinai, Der Islam 88 (2012) · Luther on Luke 2
